theorem _root_.CompressionEval.fresh_linear_algebra_combinatorics_09 {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → ℤ) (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, f i=1) :
  (∏ i ∈ s, f i)=1 ∧ (∏ i ∈ s, (f i*g i))=∏ i ∈ s, g i :=
by constructor; exact Finset.prod_eq_one hf; apply Finset.prod_congr rfl; intro i hi; simp [hf i hi]
